research_question: At one-cell P45/D80, does moving a known-CRC-failure conventional recovery to the earliest safe time remove the next-release NRx rejection chain while preserving deadline and positive AI work?

decision_at_stake.pass: If both opposite-order seed pairs gain at least 5 correct TB per 1000 releases, have no deadline or safety-contract failures, reduce admission rejections, and finish positive AI units, develop the joint timing/admission scheme and then compare against the full strong combined baseline. This is a mechanism qualification, not a novelty claim.
decision_at_stake.fail: If either pair fails, stop this early-recovery route without adding seeds or weakening timing bounds; rethink the mechanism before any strong-baseline campaign.

if_both_outcomes_lead_to_same_action: Cancel the comparison if neither result would alter the next implementation decision.
comparison_role: ABBA mechanism ablation against the existing latest-start controller. Neither arm is the strong combined baseline.
strongest_realistic_opponent: The channel-gated, queue-aware, fixed-recovery, bounded-AI combined baseline in docs/current/SOFTWALL_STRONG_BASELINE_SPEC_KO.md; implementation and comparison are a separate required gate.

execution.operational_requalification: 200 conventional-only P90/D80 releases with zero deadline misses
execution.early_stop: Analyze after arm 2 and stop if pair 1 fails any frozen gate; otherwise finish arms 3 and 4. Preserve failed data and do not add seeds.

transaction.early_policy_rule: Only a completed invalid NeuralRx result can trigger early recovery, and only if start+25 ms+2 ms is no later than the next release. Otherwise use reserved latest start.

measurement_sources.timing: controller JSON:records[*].release_ns/fallback_actual_start_ns/fallback_early, early_fallbacks, admission_rejections, nrx_bound_violations, conv_bound_violations, fallback_not_started, fallback_calendar_final, endpoint_final

evidence_grade: B mechanism ablation only if both paired opposite-order rounds and controls pass; otherwise C diagnostic.
interpretation_limits: One cell and one endpoint at a synthetic P45/D80 radio contract. The fixed 50/25/2 ms bounds are empirical qualification, not WCET. Known early CRC failure cannot generalize to timeout, long-tail NeuralRx, or correlated multi-cell failure. A pass cannot establish full-system novelty or production HARQ deadline safety.
